options.title: How Does Hoover Dam Turn Water Into Electricity?
options.first_line: How does Hoover Dam turn the water of Lake Mead into electricity?
options.first_frame: Hoover Dam at night sliced open in 3D, lake water already rushing down a glowing pipe inside it toward a spinning turbine, as the camera pushes in.

options.title: Why Does Hoover Dam Need Lake Mead to Be Full?
options.first_line: Hoover Dam makes less power when Lake Mead drops. Why does the height of a lake matter?
options.first_frame: The lake's waterline sliding down the dam's pale concrete face while the lit turbine windows below it dim one by one.

options.title: What Spins Inside Hoover Dam All Day?
options.first_line: Deep inside Hoover Dam, giant wheels spin all day. What turns them, and how do they light a city?
options.first_frame: A cutaway turbine hall deep in the dam, one huge turbine wheel spinning in blue water light, the camera diving down toward it.

why: It names Hoover Dam and raises a real how-is-that-possible question (why a lake's height changes the power) without giving the answer, and its first frame of a falling waterline dimming the turbine lights reads with the sound off.
